basis: Computed from the responsibility and dependency recorded in the data, not a prediction of real consequences. Documents are not counted: the records do not say whether their feedback is still open.
owners_note: The owners list is not limited to Engineering Leads. It takes everyone in the product who opened a PR or was assigned a bug, runs the same calculation for each, and keeps the five whose departure leaves the most open items without an owner. Ties go to the person with more affected items, then to the name.
definitions: Open work is an active bug or an open, unmerged PR. A bug's owners are the people on its latest ASSIGNED event; a PR's owner is its author. Newly unowned: open items whose only owner is the person who leaves. Affected: open items that depend (up to 4 hops, through the feature, PR and bug links in the records) on a newly unowned item.
